svg.title: South Australian investigation: all twelve monthly model-grid contexts
svg.desc: Twelve 2012 monthly paired-vector means at 100 m, at least 80 percent paired daily support per cell. Nested colors show four-neighbor components connected to the original 132 E seed at 40, 50 and 60 percent of that seed eastward peak. Gray is unsupported source data, white is supported outside these components, stars are original seeds, magenta marks unchanged section spans. Arrows show direction. These are grid-context diagnostics, not named-current identity or physical widths. Exact membership, support and directions are in south-australian-hycom-2d-flow-context.json.
